name: intersect
expr: u = intersect([1 2 3 4], [2 4 6]); s = intersect([4 2 3 1], [1 2 4], 'stable'); c = intersect([1 5i 3+4i 2], [3+4i 5i 7]); cs = intersect([1 5i 3+4i 2], [3+4i 5i 7], 'stable');
comment: Sig intersect(A,B[,setOrder]). Default 'sorted': intersect([1 2 3 4],[2 4 6]) = [2 4]. 'stable' keeps A-order: intersect([4 2 3 1],[1 2 4],'stable') = [4 2 1]. COMPLEX (C output only): exact-equality membership, |z|+angle order: intersect([1 5i 3+4i 2],[3+4i 5i 7])=[3+4i 5i], 'stable'=[5i 3+4i]. numkit previously IGNORED 'stable' (fixed) and threw on COMPLEX (added 2026-05-29).
